an7.6:1.3: Saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanam, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanam.
an7.6:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhim
an7.6:2.3: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho . . . pe . . . buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an7.6:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā pativirato hoti . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā pativirato hoti.
an7.6:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako hirimā hoti, hiriyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.6:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako ottappī hoti, ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.6:6.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an7.6:7.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
an7.6:8.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti . . . pe . . . sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an7.6:9.1: Imāni kho bhikkhave satta dhanānī ti.
